If you wish to use the credits toward an ASU master’s or doctoral degree, you will be limited to applying 15 graduate credit hours taken prior to admission.
Financial aid is not available to nondegree students.
International students on an F-1 or J-1 visa are typically not eligible to enroll in nondegree status.
Secure written permission from your designated school official granting you permission to enroll in courses before you apply for nondegree admission.
Your application will remain active for up to two terms or as long as you are enrolled in classes.
Once your student is admitted, review their next steps for enrollment.
My ASU has everything your student will need, all in one place, including next steps and to-do items, financial and account information, and class schedule.
ASU Family offers resources, programs and opportunities to connect you and your Sun Devil with other families and the range of experiences available at ASU.

This video series offers parents and families the opportunity to hear from university experts, students and other family members about ways to support their student throughout their college experience.
ASU offers campus visit tours almost every day. It is recommended that you and your student visit ASU as early in the college decision-making process as possible.
ASU makes safety one of our top priorities.

ASU offers many safety services and resources to students including secure residence halls staffed around the clock, a full-time, full-service university police force, safety escorts, emergency call boxes located throughout all ASU campuses and parking garages that connect directly to the police department, an alert system to immediately contact students in the event of a campus emergency, and a safety smartphone app called LiveSafe.
To help your student pay for college, you can apply for a Parent PLUS Loan. You must have good credit history to apply for this loan, which is offered by the federal government.
If you are an active duty member or veteran of the U.S. military, your student could be eligible for tuition benefits under the Post-9/11 GI Bill.
